title: Terms & Conditions
intro: The terms you agree to when you order from us or book us for an event.

sections.heading: Placing an order
text: An order is confirmed when we send you a confirmation, not when you submit the form. Until then we may decline it - most often because a flavour has sold out that morning.
Prices include VAT where it applies and are the ones shown at the moment you order.

sections.heading: Freshness and delivery
text: Everything is pressed the day it leaves us. Orders placed before the daily cut-off go out that afternoon; later ones go the next working morning.
Because it is a fresh product with no preservatives, keep it refrigerated and drink it within the date on the bottle.

sections.heading: Changes and cancellation
text: You can change or cancel an order free of charge up to the cut-off time on the day it is due to be pressed.
After pressing has started we cannot cancel it, because the product cannot be resold - this is the usual exception for perishable goods.

sections.heading: Event bookings
text: A date is held once a deposit is received. The balance is due on the day.
Cancel more than 14 days ahead and the deposit is returned in full; inside 14 days it covers the cane and staff already committed.

sections.heading: If something is wrong
text: Tell us the same day and we will replace it or refund it - your choice. We do not ask you to return a perishable product.
None of this affects your statutory rights.

sections.heading: Our liability
text: We are responsible for loss you suffer as a foreseeable result of us breaking these terms. We are not responsible for anything unforeseeable.
We never limit our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, or for fraud.

contact.heading: Something unclear?
contact.text: Ask before you order rather than after - we would rather explain it now.
